title: •_Conquest_
caption: •_Conquest_ (V)
game_text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Once per turn, may lose 1 Force to cancel an Interrupt targeting a starship here. [Ship-docking]
lore: One of the Imperial cruisers that chased the _Millennium Falcon_ from Tatooine. It scanned the _Falcon_ just before Han punched his starship to lightspeed.

notes: Unique. 'Conquest' italic in the slip's heading, caption and on the printed title (marked _…_); 'IMPERIAL' italic in the banner. Stats POWER 8 / ARMOR 5 / HYPERSPEED 3 (printed 9/6/3); deploy 8 / forfeit 8 (printed 8/9). Scomp-link ring → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: yellow DS pilot helmet (permanent-pilot), red nav computer. The slip prints '[Ship-docking]' literally. Slip text matches the stub. Printed face = 'Conquest (Original)' (decipher-archive scan 350×490, square-on, used as src); the 745 px ANH-D-conquest.gif is the D-E1 errata face — downloaded to src/vs14/23-ANH-D-conquest.gif for art only. Lore corrected from scan: _Millennium Falcon_ and _Falcon_ italic (wiki plain). Copyright 1996 legible on the 745 face. Modern: V0-D-conquest.gif (745 px) is the PC's Set 0 Conquest (V) (different text) — art backport only; V0 _ai alternate image and VB1 -pre (348 px, this slip reissued) also exist, not downloaded.
